About NeoSculpt6

Led by Doctors, Not by Packages

Six Specialities. One Doctor-Led Clinic.

At NeoSculpt6 you are not handed to a counsellor or a technician. Your concern is assessed, your plan is designed and your procedure is led by a senior specialist and the same doctor follows your recovery. Dermatology and plastic surgery, under one roof.
